record.paper_title: Three open problems in function theoretic operator theory
record.original_question: Let p(z) = product_{k=1}^n (z - z_k) be a complex polynomial of degree n >= 2. Define sigma_infinity(p) = min_{c in C} max_{1 <= k <= n} |z_k - c|, the radius of the smallest closed disk containing all zeros of p. If zeta is any point in the convex hull of the zeros z_1, ..., z_n, must the closed disk centered at zeta with radius sigma_infinity(p) contain a critical point of p?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.3 (Schmeisser's conjecture). Let p be a polynomial of degree n >= 2

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p(z) = \prod_{k=1}^n (z - z_k)$ be a complex polynomial of degree $n \geq 2$ with zeros $z_1, \dots, z_n \in \mathbb{C}$ (listed with multiplicity). Define
$$\sigma_\infty(p) = \min_{c \in \mathbb{C}} \max_{1 \leq k \leq n} |z_k - c|,$$
the radius of the smallest closed disk in $\mathbb{C}$ that contains all of the zeros of $p$. Let $K = \mathrm{conv}\{z_1, \dots, z_n\}$ denote the convex hull of the zeros of $p$.

Prove or disprove the following: for every $\zeta \in K$, the closed disk
$$\overline{D}(\zeta, \sigma_\infty(p)) = \{ z \in \mathbb{C} : |z - \zeta| \leq \sigma_\infty(p)\}$$
contains at least one critical point of $p$ (i.e., a zero of the derivative $p'$).
artifact.status_search_result: Schmeisser's conjecture is a strengthening of the Sendov conjecture, replacing the requirement that $\zeta$ be a zero of $p$ with $\zeta$ being any point in the convex hull of the zeros. While Sendov's conjecture itself has been proven only in special cases and remains open in general for arbitrary degree, the Schmeisser strengthening is correspondingly open. Recent work (e.g., on intersections of convex hulls of polynomial shifts and partial bounds of the form $|z-\zeta|\le\sqrt{1-|\zeta|^2}$ for $\zeta$ in the convex hull of critical points) addresses related and weaker forms but does not settle Schmeisser's conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Intersections of Convex Hulls of Polynomial Shifts and Critical Points
status_evidence.snippet: If all zeros of p lie in the closed unit disk, then for every ζ in the convex hull of the critical points, the disk |z−ζ|≤√(1−|ζ|²) contains a critical point of p.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial result related to Schmeisser's conjecture; the full conjecture is not established.

status_evidence.title: On Sendov's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Sendov's conjecture (a special case of Schmeisser's conjecture restricted to zeros) remains open in general degree.
status_evidence.claim: The underlying Sendov conjecture is still open, so its strengthening by Schmeisser is also open.
